FINAL DIAGNOSIS
Primary: Psoriasis Vulgaris (L40.0)
Secondary: Mild secondary infection
CLINICAL SUMMARY
Patient presented with red patches with silvery scales, dry, cracked skin. On examination, findings were
consistent with Psoriasis Vulgaris. Investigations including clinical examination, skin biopsy confirmed the
diagnosis.
TREATMENT ADMINISTERED DURING HOSPITAL STAY
1. Topical corticosteroids
2. Vitamin D analogues
3. Phototherapy
CONDITION AT DISCHARGE
Patient is clinically stable with moderate improvement in symptoms. No active complications at the time of
discharge.
